title: Embedding of a recursive majority block
statement: For each natural number $d$ and each block index $i\in\{0,1,2\}$, there is an injective map from the $3^d$ coordinates into the $3^{d+1}$ coordinates that places each coordinate in block $i$ under the canonical decomposition into three blocks of size $3^d$.
